title: Build on a fresh machine: drop /home/langwei paths from .cargo/config.toml
description: WOLFSSL_DIR/WOLFSSL_SRC/WOLFHSM_SRC/WOLFTPM_SRC and an rpath pointed at the lost machine. WOLFSSL_SRC now points at the bundled submodule, and WOLFSSL_SETTINGS_INCLUDE at wolfssl-src (needed by the wolfHSM/wolfTPM build scripts).
